summary: Project previously had Spotify, YouTube, and SoundCloud music integrations. User wants all music-related features removed entirely, leaving a clean slate.
known_issues: AI repeatedly failed to execute the music removal request — may need to break the task into smaller steps

existing_features.title: Delete or fully gut all music-related frontend pages: Music.tsx, Playlists.tsx, PlaylistDetail.tsx, Favorites.tsx (song-favorites version), AlbumDetail.tsx, ArtistDetail.tsx. Replace any removed pages with a simple placeholder or redirect so the router does not break.

Remove all music-related components: MusicPlayer.tsx, SongCard.tsx, TrackCard.tsx, AddToPlaylistModal.tsx, and MusicTickerWidget.tsx. Remove MusicPlayerProvider and MusicPlayerContext.tsx. Remove any persistent MusicPlayer rendered in App.tsx.

Delete all music-related services and hooks: musicApiService.ts, spotifyService.ts, youtubeService.ts, soundcloudService.ts, useMusicSearch.ts, usePlaylists.ts, useSongFavorites.ts, and the music-related parts of useQueries.ts (song favorites queries/mutations).
Delete all music-related data files: music.ts, generatedMusic.ts, fallbackMusic.ts. Delete frontend/src/types/music.ts (Song, Playlist interfaces).

Update App.tsx to remove all music-related route definitions (music, playlists, playlist detail, artist detail, album detail), remove MusicPlayerProvider wrapper, and remove the persistent MusicPlayer component. Update Layout.tsx to remove navigation links to music pages. Update Home.tsx to remove the Music section navigation card.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove all music-related features (Spotify, YouTube, SoundCloud integrations, music UI, and related code)

Remove all music-related backend state and functions from backend/main.mo: delete song favorites storage, all song favorites query/update/delete methods, and any music-specific types or imports. Keep user profile management and URL favorites intact.
